question.prompt: Postman Pete has a pedometer to count his steps. The pedometer records up to \(99999\) steps, then flips over to \(00000\) on the next step. Pete plans to determine his mileage for a year. On January \(1\) Pete sets the pedometer to \(00000.\) During the year, the pedometer flips from \(99999\) to \(00000\) forty-four times. On December \(31\) the pedometer reads \(50000.\) Pete takes \(1800\) steps per mile. Which of the following is closest to the number of miles Pete walked during the year?

solutions.explanation:
One complete counter cycle represents \(100{,}000\) steps: \(99{,}999\) steps reach \(99999\), and one more returns the display to \(00000\).

The \(44\) complete cycles, followed by the final reading of \(50{,}000\), give
\[
44\cdot100{,}000+50{,}000
=4{,}450{,}000
\]
steps. At \(1800\) steps per mile, Pete walked
\[
\frac{4{,}450{,}000}{1800}
\approx2472.2
\]
miles. This is below \(2500\), and every other listed choice is larger than \(2500\), so the closest choice is \(\boxed{2500}\) miles, choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
solutions.title: Count complete counter cycles and convert to miles
